_README: Commit a change to this file to request an immediate MLB pre-game model run (.github/workflows/mlb-pregame-signals.yml). The workflow runs the owner's model (MasterSite S14) walk-forward chain and ingests its predictions as MEASUREMENT rows; pre-game SNAPSHOT rows activate when the model CLI grows a `predict` command. Bump `request` so the push is a real change.
requested_by: arena session 01a0c625 — first run of the S14 pre-game probability capture (ROADMAP Next #3(c)). Expected: data/mlb-pregame/predictions/<date>.json with walk-forward measurement rows (timely:false) from the model's predictions.csv, and a status report naming the still-missing `predict` command in mlb_predict/cli.py.
why: A pre-game probability is only a signal if it EXISTED before first pitch. Walk-forward rows measure the model against the store's recorded Kalshi prices; only snapshots (capturedAt < firstPitchAt) can ever trigger MLBPreGame_ModelEdge.
